const ctx = $('Convert to ArchiMate XML').first().json;
const { fullXml, projectSlug, jobId, projectId } = ctx;

// Skip git script if fullXml is missing
if (!fullXml) {
  return [{ json: { ...ctx, gitScript: '# No XML to commit', skipGit: true } }];
}

const repoDir = '/opt/workspace/software-delivery';
const projectDir = repoDir + '/' + projectSlug + '-docs';
const orgDir = repoDir + '/org-architecture';
const remote = 'git@github.com:shlapolosa/software-delivery.git';

// Escape content for heredoc
const safeHeredoc = (content, marker) => content ? content.replace(new RegExp(marker, 'g'), marker + '_ESC') : '';

// Extract element lines from fullXml
const elementLines = fullXml.split('\n').filter(line => line.includes('<element ')).join('\n');

let sh = `set -e
mkdir -p /opt/workspace

# Clone or fetch repo
if [ ! -d '${repoDir}/.git' ]; then
  git clone '${remote}' '${repoDir}'
fi
cd '${repoDir}'
git fetch origin --prune

# Reset and checkout main
git reset --hard HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout main 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b main origin/main 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b main
git reset --hard origin/main 2>/dev/null || true
git pull origin main --rebase 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p '${orgDir}'

# Write elements to temp file
NEW_ELEMENTS_FILE='/tmp/new_elements_${jobId}.txt'
MERGED_FILE='/tmp/merged_${jobId}.archimate'
ORG_FILE='${orgDir}/full.archimate'

cat > "$NEW_ELEMENTS_FILE" <<'EOFNEW_${jobId}'
` + elementLines + `
EOFNEW_${jobId}

# Merge with existing org-architecture
if [ -f "$ORG_FILE" ] && ! grep -q '<<<<<<' "$ORG_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
  EXISTING_ELEMENTS=$(grep '<element ' "$ORG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
  ALL_ELEMENTS=$(cat "$NEW_ELEMENTS_FILE"; echo "$EXISTING_ELEMENTS")
  UNIQUE_ELEMENTS=$(echo "$ALL_ELEMENTS" | sort -t'"' -k4,4 -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
else
  UNIQUE_ELEMENTS=$(cat "$NEW_ELEMENTS_FILE")
fi

# Build merged org-architecture file
cat > "$MERGED_FILE" <<'EOFHDR'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<archimate:model xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:archimate="http://www.archimatetool.com/archimate" name="Organization Architecture" id="org-arch-001">
  <folder name="Business" type="business">
EOFHDR

echo "$UNIQUE_ELEMENTS" | grep -E 'Capability|BusinessActor|BusinessProcess|BusinessService' >> "$MERGED_FILE" || true
cat >> "$MERGED_FILE" <<'EOFBIZ'
  </folder>
  <folder name="Application" type="application">
EOFBIZ

echo "$UNIQUE_ELEMENTS" | grep -E 'ApplicationComponent|ApplicationInterface|DataObject' >> "$MERGED_FILE" || true
cat >> "$MERGED_FILE" <<'EOFTAIL'
  </folder>
  <folder name="Relations" type="relations">
  </folder>
</archimate:model>
EOFTAIL

mv "$MERGED_FILE" "$ORG_FILE"
rm -f "$NEW_ELEMENTS_FILE"

git add 'org-architecture/full.archimate'
git commit -m 'Merge architecture from ${projectSlug} into org-architecture (job ${jobId})' || true

for i in 1 2 3; do
  if git push origin main; then
    echo "Successfully pushed to main on attempt $i"
    break
  else
    echo "Push failed, pulling and retrying (attempt $i)..."
    git pull origin main --rebase || git pull origin main -X theirs
    git add 'org-architecture/full.archimate'
    git commit -m 'Merge architecture from ${projectSlug} (retry)' || true
  fi
done

# Create project branch and save full.archimate
git checkout -B '${projectSlug}' 'origin/${projectSlug}' 2>/dev/null || git checkout -B '${projectSlug}'
mkdir -p '${projectDir}/architecture'

`;

// Write project full.archimate
sh += "cat > '" + projectDir + "/architecture/full.archimate' <<'EOFFULL_" + jobId + "'\n" + safeHeredoc(fullXml, 'EOFFULL_' + jobId) + "\nEOFFULL_" + jobId + "\n";

sh += `
git add '${projectSlug}-docs/architecture'
git commit -m 'Add architecture for ${projectSlug} (job ${jobId})' || true
git push -u origin '${projectSlug}'
`;

return [{ json: { ...ctx, gitScript: sh } }];
